metadata.libcurl_version: 8.7.1; fixed mobile gate build; HTTP/1.1; no TLS
metadata.build_mode: profile device run; optimized native artifacts
metadata.transport_protocol_scope: plain HTTP; server protocol header recorded; no HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 work
metadata.timing_boundary: wall clock starts immediately before the transport operation and ends after response/file completion; deterministic hash validation is outside the timed large download interval

resource_measurement.peak_rss: ProcessInfo.currentRss sampled during measured operations when supported
resource_measurement.cpu: unavailable: no reliable process CPU API used in the mobile app

metadata.practical_equivalence: differences below 5 percent are treated as practically equivalent unlesscorrectness or resource behavior differs materially
